themes.evidence: Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for multimodal ingestion, preprocessing, filtering, and annotation.
run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data
Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation
Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards
ability to communicate technical findings clearly to research and product teams

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day work is curating datasets, building ingestion/preprocessing pipelines, running data ablations, and doing exploratory/statistical analysis of large unstructured datasets ('Analyze real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance') — data engineering plus analysis, not building agents or client-facing products.
notes: Despite being on a frontier-AI team, this is NOT an LLM-app/agent-building role — it is upstream training-data work (curation, ablations, pipelines). Downstream tailoring should lead with Python/Pandas data-pipeline and statistical-analysis achievements over agent-orchestration projects; JD also weights responsible-AI/data-governance collaboration, and preferred quals mention Spark/Ray/Beam-scale processing. Wide IC4 band ($119.8K–$234.7K), US remote.
